description: This file defines functions and constants related to Linux cgroups, specifically for managing and querying CPU and memory cgroup information, including parsing mount info and cgroup files.

classes.name: CGroups
classes.description: A map of cgroup subsystem names to CGroup objects, representing the cgroups of a process.

methods.name: NewCGroups
methods.description: Creates a new CGroups object by parsing mountinfo and cgroup files for a process.

methods.name: NewCGroupsForCurrentProcess
methods.description: Creates a new CGroups object for the current process.

methods.name: CPUQuota
methods.description: Returns the CPU quota for the cgroup, as a float, along with a boolean indicating if it is set, and an error if any.
